query:
SELECT EXISTS (
                 SELECT 1 FROM intents_view v
                 JOIN events e ON e.type = 'intent_proposed'
                   AND e.body->>'intent' = v.intent_id::text
                 WHERE v.agent_id = $1 AND v.state = 'confirmed'
                   AND e.body->'proposal'->'to'->'address' = $2
               ) AS "paid!"
